performance.metric: Slot count — conductor slots per platform (Tarpon KMSE/AJK WHP)
performance.basis: KMSE and AJK WHPs: three 20-inch conductor slots internal to caisson, two utilised and one spare

performance.metric: Well bay — wellhead flowline connections, design growth (West Desaru WSS)
performance.basis: West Desaru WSS topsides: wellhead flowline connections grew from 18 slots at outset to 28 because of drilling/completion scope growth

performance.metric: Christmas tree / wellhead — API 6A pressure classes
performance.basis: WellheadNet API 6A explainer prints the classes 2,000 / 3,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 15,000 / 20,000 psi (138 / 207 / 345 / 690 / 1,034 / 1,379 bar) plus an extended 20,000 psi class; API 6A governs the design, manufacture, testing and documentation of wellhead and christmas tree equipment, with ISO 10423 technically equivalent (secondary vendor explanation, not the standard text)

performance.metric: Christmas tree / wellhead — API 6A temperature classes
performance.basis: WellheadNet API 6A explainer prints K -60 to 82 C (-75 to 180 F), L -46 to 82 C (-50 to 180 F), P -29 to 82 C (-20 to 180 F), R -18 to 121 C (0 to 250 F), S -18 to 149 C (0 to 300 F), T -18 to 121 C (0 to 250 F)

performance.metric: Well bay — well slots on a minimum facility platform versus a conventional platform (PTTEP Arthit MFP)
performance.basis: JPT: the MFP has 'between 9 and 15 well slots' against 16 on a conventional platform in the same field; it ties back to the existing central wellhead platform by subsea pipeline

advantages: Minimum-facility WHPs avoid onboard processing by exporting fluids to a host
limitations: Many component figures are not published on freely readable pages; gaps are recorded
